assembly: pikepdf native page append; no page rasterization or font rewriting
font_policy: Regular source Times-like Hangul uses Windows Batang at the original point size; existing native ASCII, Latin, math, bold, sans and italic glyphs retain their original programs and painting.
spacing_policy: Natural left-to-right inline horizontal packing with one quarter-em word spaces; source display equations and figures remain at original positions; source content centers retained.

actual_native_math_visible_ink.method: After native x movement, before new Hangul insertion: actual clip-aware retained-body glyph ink versus final rendered proof; original clips/Form/vector programs also verified by native movement QA.

original_source_requested_dx_ink_audit.method: Original input glyph outlines with composed SVG ancestor transforms, shifted independently and rendered without text clips; reference<32 versus actual minRGB<220.

new_hangul_native_graphics_overlap.method: Independent new Hangul outline reference versus clip-aware actual native non-text foreground.

body_hangul_replacement_coverage.method: All actual source regular-serif Hangul body glyphs outside reviewed figure bounds, with original placement italic-role exclusions, must occur exactly in the erasure journal.

stationary_original_grading_columns.method: Independent source vertical cell primitives plus original top-level, non-prose numeric glyphs in the page right grading columns; every original grading glyph must remain at its source position.
